'''Cellvanta Grathan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was the wife of the rebel [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and mother of [[Beelzlit Grathan]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I married Lord Grathan for power. It was a means to an end--now I want out. I'm strong, but can't touch my husband. How long I've waited for someone to end his oppressive rule.|Cellvanta Grathan, to Darth Baras's apprentice|<ref name="TOR:LW" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> she lived in [[Lord Grathan's estate|her husband's estate]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she remained with her son until the arrival of [[Empire's Wrath|Darth Baras' apprentice]], who was sent to kill her son, Beelzlit. Cellvanta attempted to protect her son from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and quickly told him to run, but Beelzlit fought to protect her instead. The mother and son engaged the [[Sith Warrior]] in a fight but were easily defeated.<ref name="TOR:LW" />

{{GameDS}}
Badly beaten, Cellvanta begged for mercy pleading to know what she or her son had done wrong. Realizing that her husband had gotten both her and her son Beelzlit into the whole Sith affair due to both his political dealings, she tried to bargain with the Apprentice. Hoping to save her son, she offered the Sith Warrior her husband, Lord Grathan's, life in exchange for Beelzlit's. The Sith Warrior refused her offer and chose to kill them both. Cellvanta quickly told her son again to run, but Beelzlit chose to remain behind and die alongside her. Cellvanta was stabbed by the Sith Warrior before she could do anything more.<ref name="TOR:LW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
If Cellvanta is spared for a light side option, she convinces the Sith Warrior to kill her husband and allow her son to take his place. If the Sith Warrior is male, after he kills Grathan, she offers the Sith apprentice the chance to become "intimate".<ref name="TOR:LW" /> She later sends a gift to the Sith Warrior through [[Ralesk]], her former husband's top assassin. Possibly unknown to her, her son also tasked him with silencing them, so his secret identity would remain a secret. Ralesk fails in his attempt, being defeated by the Sith Warrior, both intents remaining unaccomplished.
